hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that runs a bonding curve for newly launched ERC-20 tokens, blocking external liquidity additions and managing all liquidity internally. When the bonding curve supply cap is reached, liquidity migrates to a full-range AMM pool. A 5% swap fee is collected via afterSwapReturnsDelta, split between the platform (1%), creator (1%), and a reward pool (3%).
